source_claim: AlphaEvolve Section 2.1 and Figure 2 frame the task specification as user-provided initial program components, evaluation code, prompt template and configuration, LLM choices, and optional background knowledge before the evolutionary loop
claim_boundary: This boundary records that LibreEvolve emits a startup task-spec bundle, a standalone task_specification.json artifact, and a runtime artifact-resolution report that links task-spec fields to manifest paths, candidate history, prompt history, evaluator rows, LLM calls, controller-budget rows, best exports, marked evolvable spans, and supported embedded score-field causality. It does not claim standalone schema completeness for the full user-provided Figure 2 contract, user-authored source identity, prompt-template content identity, config artifact identity, cross-field consistency validation, task-spec replay preflight, external-validator score causality, arbitrary language or build-runner task specs, user-authored standalone task-spec parity, or full AlphaEvolve task-spec parity.
